Start checks overlay access and asks Android for screen-sharing consent. Authorized frames stay in memory; no screen images are saved. Floating controls start, stop or pause aiming while sharing continues. End screen sharing or Stop ends capture. Hide overlay keeps capture running. Rotation hides the overlay safely. Candidate selection and power remain unavailable until aiming data is connected. Shots are always manual.
